title: EdgeHAR: An Edge-Native Compact Sensor Foundation Model for Human Activity Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2609.14498v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) is fundamental to ubiquitous and wearable computing, yet existing foundation models are largely designed for cloud-scale deployment and struggle with real-world sensing shifts, including unseen users, devices, sampling rates, and sensor placements. We present \textbf{EdgeHAR}, an edge-native compact sensor foundation model designed for wearable intelligence. Unlike conventional models that entangle activity knowledge with acquisition variations, EdgeHAR learns transferable representations by factorizing sensor signals into three latent codes: an \textbf{(i)Activity-Semantic Code} capturing reusable activity knowledge, a \textbf{(ii)Motion-Dynamics Code} modeling temporal patterns, and an \textbf{(iii)Acquisition-Context Code} representing sensor-specific variations. translated_title: EdgeHAR：一种面向人体活动识别的边缘原生紧凑传感器基础模型
translated_abstract: 基于传感器的人体活动识别（HAR）是普适计算与可穿戴计算的基础，然而现有的基础模型大多为云端大规模部署而设计，难以应对现实世界中的感知变化，包括未见过的用户、设备、采样率和传感器佩戴位置。我们提出了EdgeHAR，一种专为可穿戴智能设计的边缘原生紧凑传感器基础模型。与将活动知识与采集变化纠缠在一起的传统模型不同，EdgeHAR通过将传感器信号分解为三个潜在编码来学习可迁移的表示：（i）活动语义编码，用于捕获可复用的活动知识；（ii）运动动态编码，用于建模时间模式；（iii）采集上下文编码，用于表示传感器特定的变化。这种解耦设计使得模型能够在目标数据有限的情况下，高效适应新用户、新设备、新佩戴位置和新活动类别。
tldr: EdgeHAR是一种边缘原生的紧凑传感器基础模型，通过将传感器信号解耦为活动语义、运动动态和采集上下文三种潜在编码，实现了对人体活动识别中未见用户、设备、采样率和佩戴位置变化的高效适应。
en_tdlr: EdgeHAR is an edge-native compact sensor foundation model that factorizes sensor signals into activity-semantic, motion-dynamics, and acquisition-context latent codes, enabling efficient adaptation to unseen users, devices, sampling rates, and sensor placements in human activity recognition.
